description: This file defines the EditorWordsAdapter class, a RecyclerView adapter for managing and editing a list of user dictionary words within the app's settings UI. It includes nested classes for different view holders, methods for handling user interactions such as adding, editing, and deleting words, and interfaces for callback communication.

classes.name: EditorWordsAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying and editing user dictionary words, supporting multiple view types for normal, editing, and adding new words.

classes.name: EditorWordsAdapter.DictionaryCallbacks
classes.description: Interface for callback methods triggered on word deletion and update.

classes.name: EditorWordsAdapter.LoadedWord
classes.description: Base class representing a loaded word in the dictionary.

classes.name: EditorWordsAdapter.AddNew
classes.description: Subclass representing a placeholder for adding a new word.

classes.name: EditorWordsAdapter.Editing
classes.description: Subclass representing a word currently being edited.

classes.name: EditorWordsAdapter.EditorWordViewHolder
classes.description: Abstract base class for view holders managing different row types.

classes.name: EditorWordsAdapter.EditorWordViewHolderAddNew
classes.description: View holder for the 'add new word' row, handles click to add a new word.

classes.name: EditorWordsAdapter.EditorWordViewHolderNormal
classes.description: View holder for normal word display, handles editing and deletion.

classes.name: EditorWordsAdapter.EditorWordViewHolderEditing
classes.description: View holder for editing a word, handles approve and cancel actions.

methods.name: EditorWordsAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with a list of words, layout inflater, and callbacks.

methods.name: getItemViewType
methods.description: Returns the view type for a given position based on the word's state.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates appropriate view holder based on view type.

methods.name: inflateEditingRowView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for editing a word.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the view holder for a given position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items.

methods.name: addNewWordAtEnd
methods.description: Adds a new empty word entry at the end of the list and scrolls to it.

methods.name: createEmptyNewEditing
methods.description: Creates a new empty editing word object.

methods.name: bindNormalWordViewText
methods.description: Binds a normal word to a TextView.

methods.name: bindEditingWordViewText
methods.description: Binds a word to an EditText for editing.

methods.name: createNewEditorWord
methods.description: Creates a new LoadedWord object from the current text in the EditText.

methods.name: getItemPosition
methods.description: Returns the position of the current word in the list.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a LoadedWord to the view holder.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events for different view holders, including adding, editing, approving, canceling, and deleting words.

methods.name: onWordDeleted
methods.description: Callback invoked when a word is deleted.

methods.name: onWordUpdated
methods.description: Callback invoked when a word is updated.
